Acme Logistics.note: Spoke with Rahul Mehta (VP Operations). Acme runs 40 warehouses across India and loses roughly 6 hours per week per site on manual dispatch scheduling. Budget owner is the CFO, Priya Nair. Evaluating us against Zoho Creator and a custom in-house build.

Priya Nair pushed back on annual upfront pricing of Rs 38 lakh. She wants quarterly billing and a 90-day exit clause. Rahul is supportive but said procurement moves slowly. Zoho was mentioned again as cheaper.
Rahul asked for our SOC 2 report and data residency details before sharing with their security lead, Anil Verma. I promised to send both by Friday.

Demo to 6 stakeholders. Anil Verma asked about the SOC 2 report because it had not arrived. Rahul was embarrassed. Priya did not attend. Competitor Zoho came up a third time. Dispatch automation demo landed well.
Rahul says the deal is still alive but Priya is leaning toward a 6-month pilot instead of the annual contract. Decision meeting is on 12 November.

Brightpath Health.note: Met Dr. Meera Iyer (COO) and Suresh Rao (CFO) of Brightpath Health, a 22-clinic network in Hyderabad. Problem: appointment scheduling errors across clinics. Evaluating us against Zoho Creator.

Suresh Rao rejected annual upfront pricing of Rs 24 lakh. He asked for quarterly billing. We offered quarterly billing plus a 6-month pilot with an option to convert to annual. Suresh said that removed his objection.
Their security lead asked for the SOC 2 report. We sent the report and data residency details within 24 hours. Meera said the fast response built trust with the security team.
Demo attended by Meera, Suresh and the security lead, so every decision maker was in the room. Zoho was mentioned once as cheaper. We answered with the pilot terms and the fast security turnaround.

CLOSED WON. Brightpath Health signed the 6-month pilot and converted to annual after the pilot. What worked: offering quarterly billing and a pilot early, sending security documents within 24 hours, and getting the CFO into the demo.

Nova Retail.note: Spoke with Karan Malhotra (Head of Operations) at Nova Retail, 60 stores across Karnataka and Tamil Nadu. Problem: stock replenishment delays. CFO Anita Desai was not on the call. Comparing us against Zoho Creator.
Quoted annual upfront pricing of Rs 30 lakh. Karan said it was too high. We did not offer quarterly billing or a pilot. We have not spoken to the CFO yet.
Karan requested the SOC 2 report. We took 13 days to send it because the document was not ready. Karan said the delay worried their security team.
Demo to Karan and two managers. CFO Anita Desai did not attend. Zoho was mentioned twice as cheaper. We had no answer on price flexibility.
CLOSED LOST to Zoho on price. What went wrong: never engaged the CFO, no quarterly billing or pilot offered, SOC 2 report sent 13 days late, and the CFO never attended a demo.
